reason: The cited evidence (E2) states that Co-FCVAD is used to prepare AlCrTiZrMo HEA films and that the synergistic interaction at high temperature and changes in properties after annealing are studied, which directly supports the preparation method and the general idea of annealing-induced property changes. However, the specific formation of ZrTiO4, the exact annealing conditions (800 °C for 1 h), and the quantitative improvements in oxidation, hardness, and wear are not mentioned in the cited passages, leaving several key premises without direct evidential support.
premises: Co-FCVAD can produce multi-component HEA films with controlled composition and quality
AlCrTiZrMo HEA film is a suitable system for high-temperature corrosion/wear resistance
Annealing at ~800 °C induces synergistic elemental interaction forming a dense composite oxide (e.g., ZrTiO4)
The formed oxide layer acts as a barrier improving oxidation resistance, hardness, and wear properties
The intervention is effective under aggressive high-temperature (~800 °C) oxidizing/tribocorrosion conditions
